source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the uniform separator between equal-sized panels.
    split = None
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and c == w - c - 1:
            split = ("v", c)
            break
    if split is None:
        for r in range(h):
            if all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r]) and r == h - r - 1:
                split = ("h", r)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("uniform separator not found")
    axis, i = split
    if axis == "v":
        left = [row[:i] for row in grid]
        right = [row[i + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        left = grid[:i]
        right = grid[i + 1:]
    common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    background = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if a == b else background for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
'''
